title: ‘Blofeld-69-420’, With Guy English
description: Guy English returns to the show to talk about video games, the cold, the Heat, and the state of streaming video services.

title: ‘He Looked Like a Fred’, With John Moltz
description: Special guest: John Moltz. Special topics: Apple’s record-breaking but somehow yawn-inducing quarterly results, new features in the upcoming releases of MacOS 12.3 and iOS 15.4, the Neil Young–Joe Rogan Spotify saga, and more.

title: ‘See Me After Class’, With Jason Snell
description: Jason Snell returns to the show to dissect the Six Colors 2021 Apple Report Card. Also: the care and feeding of mechanical keyboards.

title: ‘That’ll Pivot His Tables’, With Rene Ritchie
description: Rene Ritchie returns to the show to talk about unwanted AirTag tracking, and what we expect from Apple’s rumored March product event.

title: ‘2006: Hard Work’, With Ken Kocienda
description: Special guest Ken Kocienda, author of Creative Selection, joins the show to talk about his years at Apple and the creation of the original iPhone.

title: ‘Billionaires Have Beefs’, With Tom Watson and Daniel Agee
description: Special guests Tom Watson and Daniel Agee join the show to talk about Glass, their upstart photo sharing app and community.

title: ‘A Cold Glass in Hell’, With Casey Liss
description: Special guest Casey Liss joins the show to talk about Apple’s new Studio Display and what makes a good martini.

title: ‘Doggy Lake’, With Matthew Panzarino
description: Matthew Panzarino returns to the show to talk about Apple’s new Mac Studio and Studio Display.

title: ‘Fussy Typography Improvements’, With Paul Kafasis
description: Paul Kafasis returns to the show to talk about Friday Night Baseball, Rogue Amoeba’s new Audio Hijack 4 release, and a bit of speculation on WWDC.

title: ‘Devastation, Pessimism, and Rage’, With Glenn Fleishman
description: Glenn Fleishman returns to the show to talk about Elon Musk’s impending acquisition of Twitter, Apple’s credibility problem when arguing against being required to allow sideloading on iOS, and Glenn’s new (and much-needed) book, Take Control of Untangling Connections.

title: ‘A Fake Crank on the Web’, With Michael Simmons
description: Michael Simmons returns to the show to talk about the Studio Display’s camera (and this week’s beta firmware update to tweak its quality), how things have gone two years into Flexibits’ move to subscription pricing for Fantastical and Cardhop, and Panic’s now-shipping Playdate.

title: ‘Like Neo Dodging Bullets’, With Zach Gage
description: Zach Gage joins the show to talk about game design and creativity, including his new game Knotwords.

title: ‘After Steve’, With Tripp Mickle
description: Special guest Tripp Mickle joins the show to talk about his new book, After Steve, reporting on the last decade at Apple.

title: ‘Joe Biden’s Gum’’, With John Moltz
description: Very special guest: John Moltz. Very special topics: flat Apple Watches, USB-C iPhones, and more.

title: ‘Live From WWDC 2022’, With Craig Federighi and Greg Joswiak
description: Special guests Craig Federighi and Greg Joswiak join me to discuss the news from WWDC 2022, in front of a live audience at the new Apple Developer Center at Apple Park.

title: ‘Your Sack of Meat With Teeth’, With Jason Snell
description: Jason Snell returns to the show to discuss the biggest threads from WWDC 2022 — in particular, Stage Manager and the M2 MacBook Air and 13-inch MacBook “Pro”. No sports talk (unless you count soccer).

title: ‘Here You Go, Cheapskate’, With Rene Ritchie
description: Rene Ritchie returns to the show for more on Apple’s announcements from WWDC 2022, locking devices out of Face ID and Touch ID, passkeys, and more.

title: ‘I’ve Kissed That Mouse’, With Marco Arment
description: Marco Arment returns to the show to talk about the new M2 MacBook Air and stuff.

title: ‘Shop Different’, With Michael Steeber
description: Special guest Michael Steeber joins the show to discuss his new project, The Apple Store Time Machine — an intricately-detailed explorable walkthrough of four of Apple’s original retail stores.

title: ‘Get Me to the Fainting Couch’, With John Moltz
description: Very special guest John Moltz returns to the show to talk about Center Stage, Stage Manager, and all the other stages.

title: ‘The Creaturest of Habits’, With Daniel Jalkut
description: Daniel Jalkut returns to the show. Topics include a serious discussion about CSAM detection at major cloud storage providers and messaging services. Also, a deep dive regarding the new iOS-UI-style rewrite of System Settings on the still-in-beta MacOS 13 Ventura, and thoughts on SwiftUI in general.

title: ‘An Unranted Rant’, With Rosemary Orchard
description: Special guest Rosemary Orchard joins the show to talk about her new book, Take Control of Shortcuts, and the state of automation on iOS and MacOS.

title: ‘Fluent Cupertinoese’, With Nilay Patel
description: Nilay Patel returns to the show to talk about Apple’s “Far Out” event, the iPhones 14, and The Verge’s redesign.

title: ‘Double-Digit Domains’, With Paul Kafasis
description: Paul Kafasis returns to the show to talk about the iPhone 14 Pro, Apple Watch Ultra, AirPods Pro, and Rogue Amoeba’s 20th anniversary.

title: ‘Big Booger Came After You’, With Merlin Mann
description: Merlin Mann returns to the show to talk about AI image generation (along with a few asides).

title: ‘Neither Fish Nor Fowl’, With Jason Snell
description: Jason Snell returns to the show to talk about the new 10th-gen iPad and M2 iPads Pro.

title: ‘A Fit of Pique’, With Federico Viticci
description: Federico Viticci returns to the show to talk about iPads, Stage Manager, and Apple’s ill-considered foray into expanding ads in the App Store.

title: ‘Grand Scale Foot-Shooting’, With Anil Dash
description: Special guest: Anil Dash. A little about last week’s U.S. midterm elections, and a lot about what’s going on at Twitter under Elon Musk.

title: ‘Deliberately Churned’, With Christina Warren
description: Christina Warren returns to the show to talk about the drama at Disney, tumult at Twitter, and how the hell to score Taylor Swift tickets.

title: ‘Spooky Hole’, With John Moltz
description: Friend of the show John Moltz returns to talk about Elon Musk steering Twitter into a multi-issue spat with Apple, Mastodon, and some streaming TV recommendations.

title: ‘Permanent September’, With Rene Ritchie
description: Rene Ritchie returns to the show to talk about recent news (Twitter, Freeform, iCloud Advanced Data Protection, the EU’s new Digital Markets Act) and Apple’s 2022 year in review.

title: ‘Measure Seven Times, Cut Once’, With Glenn Fleishman
description: Glenn Fleishman returns to the show to talk about reported setbacks in Apple’s silicon division, the LastPass vault leak and password management, and the frontiers of social networking. Also, the joys of modern air travel during the holidays.

title: ‘Slow-Moving Hurricane’, With Craig Hockenberry
description: Craig Hockenberry returns to the show to talk about the demise of third-party Twitter clients, the overall Twitter shitshow, touchscreens on the Mac, and the perils of autocorrect when you have a clever username.

title: ‘Tweeter and the Monkey Man’, With Dan Moren
description: Special guest Dan Moren joins the show to talk about the new M2 MacBook Pros and Mac Minis, and the triumphant return of the full-sized HomePod.

title: ‘18-Hour Bombing Mission’, With Marco Arment
description: Marco Arment returns to the show to discuss some genuinely startling revelations regarding iPhone and Apple ID security; the new HomePod 2; and our favorite electric vehicle maker. Also: coffee.

title: ‘Fine Hypertext Products’, With Jason Kottke
description: Jason Kottke returns to the show to celebrate the 25th anniversary of Kottke.org.

title: ‘The Skin of Your Pants’, With Daniel Jalkut
description: Daniel Jalkut returns to the show to talk about AI chat, new emoji, and Apple Music Classical.

title: ‘$8 Billion in Late Fees’, With Rene Ritchie
description: Rene Ritchie returns to the show to discuss generative AI (and what Apple might soon do with it), iPhone passcodes and iCloud device security, HBO Max turning into just plain Max, and Make Something Wonderful — one more thing from Steve Jobs.

title: ‘This Guy Reads a Lot Better’, With Quinn Nelson
description: Special guest Quinn Nelson joins the show to talk about Apple’s rumored AR/VR headset, Apple silicon, and more.

title: ‘The Paul McCartney of Car Salesmen’, With John Moltz
description: John Moltz, ace reporter from The Daily Planet, returns to the show. Topics include Apple pushing ads through its own built-in apps, car shopping, and the burgeoning Twitter alternative Bluesky.

title: ‘No False Humidity’, With Jason Snell
description: Special guest: Jason Snell. Topics: Headset, headseat, headset. And no baseball talk other than how games might look in VR. Also: Final Cut Pro and Logic Pro for iPad, and GM’s dumb decision to drop CarPlay.

title: ‘One True HIG’, With Neil Jhaveri
description: Neil Jhaveri, founder and lead developer of Mimestream, the terrific new native Mac email client for Gmail, joins the show to talk about email, Mac apps, and indie software development.

title: ‘guyenglish.zip’, With Guy English
description: Guy English returns to the show to talk about the live show from WWDC, Mac Pros past and future, Marathon and Mac gaming, and Apple’s seemingly imminent XR headset. And definitely not to talk about Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker.

title: ‘Live From WWDC 2023’, With John Ternus, Mike Rockwell, Craig Federighi, and Greg Joswiak
description: Back in San Jose’s historic California Theatre for the first time since 2019, special guests John Ternus, Mike Rockwell, Craig Federighi, and Greg Joswiak join me to discuss the news and announcements from WWDC 2023.

title: ‘An Extra Kick in the Nuts’, With Christian Selig
description: Christian Selig, developer of the excellent apps Apollo and Pixel Pals, joins the show to talk about Reddit’s Twitter-fication, along with highlights from WWDC 2023.

title: ‘The M Is for Magnificent’, With Matthew Panzarino
description: Matthew Panzarino returns to the show for a post-WWDC discussion about Vision Pro and VisionOS.

title: ‘Tape Deck Dongle’, With Joanna Stern
description: Joanna Stern returns to the show. Topics include the launch of Threads, Apple’s Vision Pro, and iPhone/iCloud device security.

title: ‘What’s Happening‽’, With Craig Hockenberry
description: Craig Hockenberry, the special guest with the special fleshy palms, returns to the show. Topics include Twitter/X, foldable phones, and our favorite features in iOS 17 now that it’s in public beta.

title: ‘A Photocopy of a Fax’, With Jason Snell
description: Jason Snell, come on down. You’re the next contestant on The Talk Show. Special topics: John Warnock and Adobe, Disney and Apple, the iMac’s 25th anniversary, and more.

title: ‘Pleading the Fifth’, With Michael Simmons
description: Flexibits co-founder Michael Simmons returns to the show to talk about his experience at Apple’s developer lab for Vision Pro, and his enthusiasm for the future of spatial computing.

title: ‘Who’s Heef?’, With Matthew Panzarino
description: Matthew Panzarino returns to the show to talk about the new iPhones 15.

title: ‘Gate Number Two’, With John Moltz
description: Special guest John Moltz joins the show to discuss the various iPhone 15 “-gates”, rumors of Jony Ive working with OpenAI on an “AI device”, and more.

title: ‘Are There Ever Too Many Love Songs?’, With Sebastiaan de With and Ben Sandofsky
description: Special guests Sebastiaan de With and Ben Sandofsky, co-founders of Lux, join the show to talk about their apps (Halide, Spectre, and Orion) and speculate about next week’s “Scary Fast” Apple event.

title: ‘What the Actual’, With Christina Warren
description: Christina Warren joins the show to talk about Apple’s “Scary Fast” event, introducing the new M3 MacBook Pros and 24-inch iMac.

title: ‘Two-Legged Stool’, With Gabe Rivera
description: Special guest Gabe Rivera, founder of the indispensable news aggregator Techmeme, joins the show to talk about the state of news and social media.

title: ‘The Blurry Edge of Acceptable’, With Nilay Patel
description: Nilay Patel returns to the show. Topics include the iPhones 15, journalism in the age of AI, and what it’s like to have Barack Obama on your podcast.

title: ‘Error -37’, With John Siracusa
description: Special holiday guest: John Siracusa. Special holiday topics: the Apple/Masimo patent dispute over the blood oxygen sensors in Apple Watches, the ongoing Beeper Mini/iMessage saga, iOS 17.3’s upcoming Stolen Device Protection feature, Apple’s new Journal app. Also, an ode to big-ass tower desktops.

title: ‘Halos and Harps’, With Casey Liss
description: Apple’s 2023 year in review, with Callsheet developer Casey Liss.

title: ‘An Asterisk on the Bento Box’, With Marco Arment
description: Marco Arment returns to the show. Topics include the Apple-Masimo patent dispute over Apple Watch blood oxygen sensors, the new External Payment Links entitlement for the App Store, and more.

title: ‘An Impossible Balcony’, With Matthew Panzarino
description: Matthew Panzarino — proprietor of the excellent new website/newsletter The Obsessor — returns to the show to talk about — what else? — the Vision Pro.

title: ‘I’m a Real-World Man’, With Adam Lisagor
description: Adam Lisagor returns to the show to discuss, while wearing, Apple Vision Pro.

title: ‘The Essence of Stealing’, With David Barnard
description: Special guest David Barnard joins the show. Topics include the App Store — past, present, and post-DMA future — and the excellent new update to his app Weather Up.

title: ‘Less Space Than a Nomad? Lame’, With Jason Snell
description: Jason Snell returns to the show to talk about the DOJ’s antitrust lawsuit against Apple. And sports gambling.

title: ‘You’ve Never Seen Email Like This Before’, With John Moltz
description: The one and only John Moltz returns to the show to talk about the relative dearth of original content for Vision Pro, WWDC rumors and guesses, and, yes, a wee bit about Apple’s regulatory/antitrust tribulations.

title: ‘I Decapitated the MacBook Air’, With Federico Viticci
description: Federico Viticci returns to the show to discuss MacStories’s 15th anniversary, Apple’s upcoming “Let Loose” keynote for new iPad hardware, and more.

title: ‘Canadian Girlfriend Vibes’, With M.G. Siegler
description: Special guest M.G. Siegler returns to the show to talk about the new iPad Pros, the iPadOS/MacOS functional gulf, the OpenAI/Scarlett Johansson controversy, and M.G.’s new blog Spyglass.

title: ‘Chockdingus’, With Craig Hockenberry
description: Craig Hockenberry returns to the show. Topics include the upcoming Daylight DC-1 monochrome “e-paper” tablet, more thoughts on the new iPad Pros, and what we expect/hope for from Apple at WWDC. Also: a one-button keyboard.

title: ‘Live From WWDC 2024’, With John Giannandrea, Craig Federighi, and Greg Joswiak
description: Recorded in front of a live (and lively) audience at The California Theatre in San Jose Tuesday evening, special guests John Giannandrea, Craig Federighi, and Greg Joswiak join me to discuss Apple’s announcements at WWDC 2024.

title: ‘150 Million Calculator Apps’, With Quinn Nelson
description: Quinn Nelson, renowned host of Snazzy Labs, returns to the show to recap the highlights of WWDC: Apple Intelligence, platform updates, and the latest salvos from the EC regarding Apple’s compliance with the DMA.

title: ‘Curiously Short Episodes’, With John Moltz
description: John Moltz returns to the show for a holiday-week look at the best of recent prestige streaming content, particularly Apple TV+. And, yes, a bit on the latest Apple/EU/DMA drama.

title: ‘Chutes and Ladders’, With Hunter Hillegas
description: Special guest Hunter Hillegas, author of the excellent Vegas Mate app, joins the show to discuss euphemistic emoji, the CrowdStrike fiasco, and the closing of the iconic Mirage resort in Las Vegas.

title: ‘Hock TUAW’, With Christina Warren
description: Christina Warren (a.k.a. “Mary Brown”) returns to the show. Topics include Apple’s new iOS 18.1 and MacOS 15.1 betas (featuring Apple Intelligence), a little reminiscing about Gil Amelio and Steve Jobs, and the bizarre saga of TUAW, resurrected as a zombie AI slopsite.

title: ‘Pinkie Swear’, With Chance Miller
description: Chance Miller, ace reporter (and editor-in-chief) for 9to5Mac, joins the show to talk about the latest changes to Apple’s DMA compliance plans with iOS, expectations for the September Apple event, and more.

title: ‘Good Enough to Be Pesky’, With Taegan Goddard
description: Special guest Taegan Goddard, longtime writer and founder of Political Wire, joins the show to talk about the past, present, and future of independent media.

title: ‘The Dynamic Paradox’, With Nilay Patel
description: Nilay Patel returns to the show to consider the iPhones 16.

title: ‘Shipping vs. Shipping’, With Jason Snell
description: Jason Snell returns to the show to discuss Apple’s September product announcements, and Meta’s Orion prototype AR glasses. Absolutely no baseball talk, almost.

title: ‘An Acoustic Nightmare’, With Tyler Stalman
description: Tyler Stalman joins the show to discuss the iPhone 16 lineup’s cameras, and the state of iPhone photography.

title: ‘His Most Pro Shirt’, With Dan Moren
description: Dan Moren returns to the show to discuss this week’s introductions of the first M4 Macs: iMac, Mac Mini, and MacBook Pros.

title: ‘Holiday Party 2024’, With Merlin Mann
description: This again. Jiminy. Well, once more, let’s talk around another election, and try, by doing so, to maybe express something about it.

title: ‘Annoying Friendliness’, With Joanna Stern
description: Joanna Stern returns to the show to talk about our new best friends, AI chatbots, and I chime in with how the Voight-Kampff test got it all wrong.

title: ‘A Good Duck Butt’, With Allen Pike
description: Special guest Allen Pike joins the show to talk about the state of generative AI and how Apple Intelligence measures up (so far). Also: some speculation on Apple’s pending acquisition of the ever-difficult-to-pronounce Pixelmator.

title: ‘A Professional Internet User’, With Vlad Prelovac
description: Kagi founder and CEO Vlad Prelovac joins the show to talk about the business of web search, the thinking behind Kagi’s own amazing search engine, and their upstart WebKit-based browser Orion.

title: ‘Nothing Is Possible’, With Paul Kafasis
description: Special guest: Paul Kafasis. Special topics: Siri/Super Bowl nonsense, “Gulf of Mexico/America” nonsense, the iPhone 16e gets announced, and a veritable Bond villain buys the rights to the James Bond movie franchise.

title: ‘Putting a Stink on the Letter X’, With Craig Hockenberry
description: Craig Hockenberry returns to the show. Topics include Apple’s new hardware this week — M3 iPad Airs, A16 regular iPads, M4 MacBook Airs, and the M4 Max and surprising M3 Ultra Mac Studios. And we go deep on The Iconfactory’s years-in-the-making new app, Tapestry — a universal timeline for the Internet.

title: ‘Podcasting Technology Cadence’, With MG Siegler
description: MG Siegler returns to the show to talk about the drama surrounding Siri and Apple Intelligence.

title: ‘The Best Hatched Plan’, With Glenn Fleishman
description: Special guest Glenn Fleishman returns to the show for episode 420 on 4/20, but everyone’s sober, I swear. Topics include Trump’s dumb tariffs and Glenn’s smart new edition of his book Six Centuries of Type & Printing.

title: ‘The Ratchet of Flippancy’, With Craig Mod
description: Craig Mod returns to the show to discuss his splendid new book, Things Become Other Things. Other topics include creating with AI tools (including programming), social media permanence vs. ephemerality, and more.

title: ‘A Monkey on a Rock’, With Stephen Hackett
description: Stephen Hackett, proprietor of 512 Pixels and co-founder of Relay.fm, joins the show. Topics include: IO (or if you will, io), the new joint venture of OpenAI and Jony Ive’s LoveFrom; the sheer fantasy of “Made in America” iPhones; and Fortnite’s return to the US App Store.

title: ‘Sewing Machine Repair Shop’, With Patrick McGee
description: Patrick McGee joins the show to discuss his must-read new book, Apple in China — one of the best books about Apple anyone has ever written.

title: ‘Live From WWDC 2025’, With Joanna Stern and Nilay Patel
description: Recorded in front of a live audience at The California Theatre in San Jose Tuesday evening, special guests Joanna Stern and Nilay Patel join me to discuss Apple’s announcements at WWDC 2025.

title: ‘Through the Wall Like Kool-Aid Man’, With Chance Miller
description: Chance Miller returns to the show to discuss the news and announcements from WWDC 2025.

title: ‘The Cutting Edge Latest Supermodel’, With David Smith
description: Special guest David Smith returns to the show for a developer’s perspective look at WWDC 2025.

title: ‘The Shift-2 Crowd’, With Jason Snell
description: Jason Snell returns to the show to talk about the early PC platform rivalries of the 1980s, iOS 26 leaks (and Apple suing YouTuber Jon Prosser), the various Apple OS 26 public betas and the state of Liquid Glass, and more. (Where by “more” I mean a little baseball and keyboard nerdery.)

title: ‘Michigan-Starred Fine Dining’, With Louie Mantia
description: Special guest Louie Mantia joins the show to talk about Liquid Glass, the various OS 26 updates, and the worrisome state of Apple’s UI design overall. Also: sandwiches.

title: ‘Weird Turtle Fake Out’, With Matthew Panzarino
description: Matthew Panzarino returns to the show. Topics include 007 logo creator Joe Caroff’s death at 103, Google’s weird “Made by Google” event hosted by Jimmy Fallon, the UK supposedly dropping its demand for an iCloud encryption backdoor, and Apple’s workaround for the Apple Watch blood oxygen sensor patent stalemate.

title: ‘Ersatz PopSocket’, With Andru Edwards
description: Special guest Andru Edwards joins the show. Topics include Google’s Pixel 10 event and the Pixel 10 family of devices, AI’s effect on computational photography, foldable phones, and some speculation on Apple’s September 9 “Awe Dropping” event.

title: ‘Iconic Pig Lipstick’, With John Moltz
description: John Moltz returns to the show to talk about the iPhone 17 lineup: the iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max, iPhone 17, and the no-number iPhone Air. Not one word about baseball, but some Star Wars talk may or may not have snuck in.

title: ‘You and Frank Sinatra’, With Dan Moren
description: Dan Moren returns to the show. Topics include Atlas, ChatGPT’s new web browser (or anti-web browser) for the Mac; Apple’s loss in a “landmark” regulatory lawsuit in the UK regarding App Store commission rates; multiple reports of poor sales for the iPhone Air; and Apple’s M5 product announcements: MacBook Pro, iPads Pro, and Vision Pro.

title: ‘Meat Bags’, With Brian Mueller
description: Special guest Brian Mueller, developer of Carrot Weather, joins the show to commemorate the 10th anniversary of his utterly ridiculous but totally serious weather app.

title: ‘Knee-Jerk Contrarian’, With Dan Frommer
description: Special guest Dan Frommer returns to the show. Topics include the indie media business, the iPhone Pocket, the iPhone Air (including rumors about the second generation model), AI “personalities”, and five years of Apple Silicon Macs. Also, six years of Dan’s site, The New Consumer.

title: ‘Lincoln Bio Services’, With Stephen Robles
description: Special guest Stephen Robles joins the show. Topics include indie media and YouTube, Shortcuts and automation, and the state of podcasting.

title: ‘Financial Boner’, With Tyler Hayes
description: Special guest: Tyler Hayes. Topics include how to get a small phone today, which way foldables should fold, the state of Apple TV (including its new “sonic logo”), and some holiday gift gadget recommendations.

title: ‘A Naughty Citizen’, With Quinn Nelson
description: Special guest Quinn Nelson returns for a two-topic holiday spectacular: the iPad in the wake of iPadOS 26, and Apple’s executive changes as Tim Cook seemingly nears the end of his time as CEO.

title: ‘2025 Year in Review’, With Rene Ritchie
description: A look back at Apple’s 2025, with special guest Rene Ritchie.

title: ‘A Mitigated Disaster’, With Daniel Jalkut
description: Daniel Jalkut returns to the show so we can both vent about MacOS 26 Tahoe.

title: ‘Flush a Radar’, With Brent Simmons
description: Brent Simmons returns to the show. Topics include NetNewsWire 7, MacOS 26 Tahoe, and I guess, some other stuff.

title: ‘Serious Opinionators’, With Adam Engst
description: Adam Engst returns to the show to talk, in detail, about certain of the UI changes in iOS 26 and Apple’s version 26 OSes overall. In particular, the new Unified view in the Phone app, and the Filter pop-up menu in both the Phone and Messages apps. Also: a shoutout to Balloon Help.

title: ‘Bad Dates’, With Jason Snell
description: Jason Snell returns to the show to discuss the 2025 Six Colors Apple Report Card, MacOS 26 Tahoe, Apple Creator Studio, along with what we expect/hope for in next week’s Apple product announcements.

title: ‘The Pogue Feature’, With David Pogue
description: Special guest David Pogue discusses his excellent, entertaining, and amazingly comprehensive new book, Apple: The First 50 Years.

title: ‘You’re Going to Have the Niggles’, With Christina Warren
description: Christina Warren returns to the show to discuss Apple’s big month of product announcements — in particular, the iPhone 17e and MacBook Neo. And we pour one out for the Mac Pro.

title: ‘Apple at 50’, With John Siracusa
description: Who better to join the show to commemorate Apple’s 50th anniversary than John Siracusa?

title: ‘Food and Beverage Director’, With MG Siegler
description: MG Siegler returns to the show to discuss Apple’s announcement that Tim Cook is stepping aside (into the role of executive chairman) and John Ternus will become CEO.

title: ‘A Sociopathic Father’, With Adam Lisagor
description: Adam Lisagor returns to the show to talk about Hovercraft, his new virtual presentation camera app for Mac, and how he’s developing it with AI coding tools. Also, delicious Japanese spite sandwich cookies.

title: ‘Twins Named John’, With Stephen Hackett
description: Stephen Hackett returns to the show to help me make sense of a problem that is hard even to describe, let alone solve, regarding Apple One, family sharing, a separate Media & Purchasing account, and iCloud storage space. Also: what we’re expecting from WWDC 2026.

title: ‘Live From WWDC 2026’, With Joanna Stern and Nilay Patel
description: Recorded in front of a live audience at The California Theatre in San Jose on Tuesday 9 June 2026, special guests Joanna Stern and Nilay Patel join John Gruber to discuss Apple’s announcements at WWDC 2026.

title: ‘Perp Walk for Selfies’, With Jason Snell
description: Jason Snell returns to the show for a look back at WWDC 2026, and a look ahead to Designed in California, his and Myke Hurley’s upcoming 50-episode Apple history podcast.

title: ‘Taking Drugs to Get Fat’, With John Moltz
description: The great John Moltz returns to the show. Topics include Apple’s hardware price hikes in response to the global RAM/SSD shortage, and some spitballing on what we like about the UI changes in the MacOS 27 Golden Gate beta.

title: ‘A Scam Held Together With Patriotism and Golden Paint’, With Quinn Nelson
description: Quinn Nelson returns to the show to discuss OpenAI’s ChatGPT/Codex “native” app migration fiasco, Siri AI in Apple’s OS 27 betas, MacOS 27 Golden Gate, and the hottest new cell phone of the year, the Trump T1.

title: ‘What’s in Louie’s Wallet’, With Louie Mantia
description: Louie Mantia returns to the show to talk about the state of UI and icon design on Apple’s platforms, and some speculation on Apple’s trade secret lawsuit against OpenAI.

title: ‘Getting the Snack Right’, With Chance Miller
description: Chance Miller returns to the show. Topics include iOS 27’s progress over summer, live baseball in Vision Pro, the RAM crisis, Apple’s trade secret lawsuit against OpenAI and io, and the EU/DMA situation.

title: ‘I’m Thinking X, Not X’, With Andru Edwards
description: Andru Edwards returns to the show to discuss Apple’s big September event and their new products: the iPhones 18 Pro and Duo, AirPods 5, and Apple Watch Series 12/Ultra 4.
